## 3MF Package (3M)

The FileDef for **3MF** — 3D Manufacturing Format, the OPC/ZIP package that modern slicers (Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, Cura) save a print job as. Sits in the 3D-model family beside `StlDef`, `GltfDef` and `GlbDef`; richer than STL, because a 3MF carries a whole build plate rather than one anonymous mesh.

```ts
export class ThreeMfDef extends ThreeDModelDef {
  static displayName = '3MF Package';
  static icon = PrinterIcon;
  static acceptTypes = '.3mf,model/3mf,application/vnd.ms-3mfdocument';
}
```

### Family position

`FileDef` → `ThreeDModelDef` → `ThreeMfDef`. The family supplies the icon and the live renderer (`Model3DPreview`) and inherits the four shared format shells (atom, fitted, embedded, isolated) and their chrome. A leaf adds **only** its `extractAttributes`, projecting that format's header facts onto the family's single `model3d` field via `model3dAttributes`. So this module is a reader, not a card design — it has no template of its own by construction.

### What it extracts

`threeMfToModel3d` projects the package header + slicer config onto `model3d`:

| `model3d` key | 3MF source |
|---|---|
| `format` | always `'3MF package'` |
| `meshes` | `printPartCount` |
| `triangles` | `configuredFaceCount` (summed from the slicer config) |
| `materials` / `materialNames` | `<basematerials>` in `<resources>` |
| `unit` | the `<model>` root's `unit` attribute |
| `generator` | the writing application |
| `designer`, `license` | `<metadata>` children |
| `plateCount`, `printPartCount`, `extruderCount` | slicer config |

Geometry counts come from the slicer config, so a 3MF with no config keeps its material and provenance facts and reports **no** geometry counts — the honest header-only answer rather than a fabricated zero.

Physical dimensions are deliberately **not** extracted. The live client-side viewer computes them instead: cheaper at index time, and correct, because it applies the build/component transforms a prologue scan would ignore.

### Why the reader is bounded (`three-mf-meta-extractor.ts`)

A 3MF's useful text metadata all sits at the **top** of the `*.model` part — the `<model>` root's namespaces and unit, the `<metadata>` children, the `<basematerials>` — every bit of it ahead of the geometry (`<object>`/`<mesh>`/`<vertices>`). The reader exploits that layout twice:

1. `unzipSync`'s `filter` runs **before** decompression, so only the `.model` and `model_settings.config` entries are decompressed. Plate-thumbnail PNGs, textures and `.rels` are never paid for.
2. Metadata is read off the model part's **prologue** (everything up to the first `<object>`) with lightweight regex — no DOM parse of the vertex/triangle body.

Pure JS (`fflate` + regex, no DOM), so it is directly unit-testable.

**ZIP-bomb backstop.** Any entry declaring a decompressed size over 128 MB is rejected. Declared sizes can be forged, so this stops the honest bomb, not an adversarial one — realm files come from authenticated members, so it is hardening, not a DoS guarantee.

### The size-cap rule that is easy to get wrong

Over `fileSizeLimitBytes` (default `DEFAULT_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT_BYTES`, the same ceiling the write path enforces), extraction is skipped and the base attributes are returned **as `ThreeMfDef`**. It must **not** throw `FileContentMismatchError` there — that would demote the file to a plain `FileDef` and lose the 3D card entirely. The file still renders through the live viewer, which parses its own geometry; it just shows an empty inspector panel and the cube placeholder.

`FileContentMismatchError` is thrown in exactly two places: a wrong extension, and a payload `parseThreeMf` cannot read (not a ZIP, no `.model` part, or a `.model` whose root isn't the 3MF core `<model>` element).

### Related types

`ThreeMfMetadata` and `ThreeMfPrintPartData` are TypeScript interfaces inside the extractor, **not** `FieldDef` classes. The FieldDef their values land on is the family's shared `Model3dMetadataField` in `file-formats/metadata-fields.gts`.

### Examples

Linked as a `fileExamples` entry: `filedef-fixtures/samples/three-mf-moderate.3mf`.

### Siblings

`gltf-model-def` and `glb-model-def`. The fourth leaf under `ThreeDModelDef`, `StlDef`, has no Spec in this realm.
